final: WITH m AS (SELECT mt.Name AS Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL)/t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpm FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId=t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name) SELECT Name, avg_bpm, avg_bpm - (SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) FROM m) AS diff_from_overall FROM m WHERE avg_bpm > (SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) FROM m)
